announcement.message: CMS preview: updates from WordPress appear here.

notices.title: Website preview: a notice from WordPress
notices.excerpt: This entry demonstrates how a published notice appears on the public website.
body: This is fixture content used to preview the website sync. It is not an official school notice.
When the website is connected to WordPress, approved notices published by the school replace this entry.

notices.title: Website preview: a second notice
notices.excerpt: A second entry shows how several notices are ordered by their website date.
body: The newest notice appears first. The date shown here is the date entered in WordPress, not the date the page was built.
Fixture content exists only for previewing the site before launch.

events.title: Website preview: an upcoming event
events.excerpt: This fixture entry demonstrates the upcoming state on the events page.
body: Events dated after today are grouped as upcoming. This fixture date is intentionally in the future.
Replace this preview with approved school content before launch.

events.title: Website preview: a past event
events.excerpt: This fixture entry demonstrates how an earlier event is grouped in the archive.
body: The website derives the past state from the event date in Indian Standard Time.
This is preview content, not a record of an actual school event.

calendar.title: Website preview: a calendar entry
calendar.description: A fixture calendar entry showing how a dated item appears in the school calendar.

galleries.title: Website preview: photographs from WordPress
galleries.description: Two approved photographs demonstrate how a gallery collection is downloaded, optimised and published.
notes: Photographs appear only when consent, a consent reference and alternative text are recorded.
This collection is fixture content for previewing the site.

photos.alt: A large group of students in white and blue uniforms gathered in a circle around a playground slide on a red-earth school ground, with a teacher standing on the slide.
photos.caption: Morning assembly on the school ground.

photos.alt: Two students in gold-trimmed traditional dance costumes with flowers in their hair, smiling at each other outdoors.
photos.caption: Two students dressed for a performance.

galleries.title: A collection awaiting photographs
galleries.description: A fixture entry reserved for photographs that are still being catalogued. No photographs are attached yet.
notes: Prints are still being catalogued and matched to their dates.
No photographs are attached until the details can be confirmed.
